task: changepoint-detector flagship: short returns round 5, same-count day-shift nulls and a real-drop guard

errors.what: First draft of the eval imported autoCandidates from eval/update-rate-returns-auto.mjs; that module installs its own worker message handler at import, so in a worker both handlers would answer. Caught before running; the rule was inlined and checked equal to round 4 on 57 series.

doc_friction.issue: eval modules that run worker pools register a parentPort handler at import time, so their exported helpers cannot be reused from another worker-pool eval without double handlers; helpers belong in a module without the worker branch.

writeups: ventures/changepoint-detector/README.md (section 'Short returns: a real drop in repeats')
notes: Pre-registered round 5 (commit 41343d76f before any cell ran). Calibration: no-guard pass reports returns on 98-100% of same-count day-shift series; 'half' guard 0 at every m with identical power; z01 needs m 6. Confirmation 'half' m 3: R1 worst 0.005, R2 196/200, R3 +196, R4 0.000, all pass. J1 (seen data) 2 of 8, bar 4: FAIL, not offered, SHORT_RETURNS.mult stays null. certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
